trips.name: YUNNAN-9D7N(MUSLIM FRIENDLY)
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur - Kunming (MOB): 3★ Kunming – Yingrong Hotel (Arrival day) Fly from Kuala Lumpur to Kunming. Meet and greet at Kunming Airport, then transfer to the hotel for check-in.
Day 2 Kunming - Chuxiong(B/L/D): 3★ Chuxiong – Yingrong Hotel (Full sightseeing day) Naigu Stone Forest; seasonal fruit picking; Chuxiong Yi Ancient Town.

Day 3 Chuxiong → Dali(B/L/D): 3★ Dali – Youtu Resort Hotel (Cultural dining experience) Travel to Dali after breakfast. Jeep photography tour; Huayu Ranch; Dali Ancient Town; Foreigner Street; Yunnan-style Peacock Banquet.
Day 4 Dali(B/L/D): 3★ Dali – Youtu Resort Hotel (Heritage and village culture) Donglianhua Natural Village; Weishan Ancient Town.

Day 5 Dali → Lijiang(B/L/D): 3★ Lijiang – James Joyce Coffetel (Romance Show optional; RM 260 per person, not included)                                                        Travel to Lijiang after breakfast. Baisha Ancient Town; Yuhu Village, the first village beneath the Snow Mountain; optional Lijiang Romance Show.

Day 6 Lijiang → Dali(B/L/D): 3★ Dali – Youtu Resort Hotel (Electric shuttle included at Ideal Land)                                                                                              Lijiang Ancient Town; Black Dragon Pool Park; return to Dali; Santorini–Ideal Land, including the electric shuttle service.

Day 7 Dali → Kunming(B/L): 3★ Kunming – Yingrong Hotel (Dinner on own) Travel to Kunming in the morning. Dianchi Lake scenery; Shuncheng Street; Kunming Old Street. Dinner on own to sample local snacks

Day 8 Kunming(B/L/D): (Departure transfer according to flight schedule)          Silk Museum; Luosiwan International Trade City; Dounan Flower Market. Transfer to the airport according to flight time.
Day 9 Kunming → Kuala Lumpur: (Tour ends)                                                              Board the flight from Kunming to Kuala Lumpur.

trips.name: SARAWAK HIGHLIGHTS - 4D3N (KUCHING-BAKO-ANNAH RAIS)
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Kuching(_/_/D): 3★ Kuching – Hotel Accommodation (Arrival & City Heritage Day)Fly into Kuching International Airport; meet the tour guide and transfer to the hotel. Sightseeing at Kuching Waterfront, Fort Margherita, the Cat Museum, and the old town shophouses along India Street and Main Bazaar. Check in at the hotel. Welcome dinner in the evening.

Day 2 Kuching → Bako National Park → Kuching(B/L/D): 3★ Kuching – Hotel Accommodation (Rainforest & Wildlife Day) Depart by road to Kampung Bako jetty, then by boat to Bako National Park headquarters. Guided rainforest trek through mangrove and sea-stack coastline in search of the proboscis monkey and other wildlife, with free time at Telok Assam beach before the return boat and road transfer to the hotel.

Day 3 Kuching → Semenggoh → Annah Rais → Kuching(B/L/D): 3★ Kuching – Hotel Accommodation (Orangutan & Bidayuh Culture Day) Morning feeding session at Semenggoh Wildlife Centre's semi-wild orangutan sanctuary, then onward to Annah Rais Longhouse for a guided walk through the Bidayuh community, a traditional lunch, and an optional dip in the natural hot spring before returning to the hotel.

Day 4 Kuching → Kuala Lumpur: Tour Ends Check out from the hotel and enjoy free time for last-minute shopping along Main Bazaar. Transfer to Kuching International Airport for the flight back to Kuala Lumpur. Tour ends with wonderful memories of Sarawak's rainforest, wildlife and Bidayuh culture.
exc: Flights
Insurance

trips.dest: Kashgar • Yarkand • Taxkorgan • Karakul Lake • Golden Poplar Forest
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Hong Kong (MOB): On Board.                                                                     Fly from Kuala Lumpur to Hong Kong. Overnight on board.

Day 2 Hong Kong → Urumqi → Korla (_/L/D): 4★ Korla Licheng Marriott Hotel or Similar                                                                                                                                                       Arrive in Urumqi and meet the tour guide. Travel to Korla via the Tianshan Victory Tunnel.

Day 3 Korla → Tires → Kuqa (B/L/D): 4★ Kuqa Yicheng Hotel or similar                                         Tarim Basin Populus Euphratica Forest, including scenic shuttle bus and mini-train; Kucha Royal Palace.

Day 4 Kuqa → Tianshan Mysterious Grand Canyon → Bachu (B/L/D): 4★ Bachu Jinjiang International Hotel or similar                                                                                                                         Tianshan Mysterious Grand Canyon; Dolan Tribe, including eco-friendly vehicle.

Day 5 Bachu → Red Sea → Kashgar (B/L/D): 4★ Kashgar Meihou Lizhi Hotel or similar                                                                                                                                                            Red Sea Scenic Area; Kashgar Old City; Id Kah Mosque.
Day 6 Kashgar → Turpan by Soft Sleeper Train (B/L/D): Overnight on train; Bulunkou White Sand Lake; Karakul Lake; view of Muztagh Ata. Continue to Turpan by soft sleeper train.

Day 7 Turpan → Urumqi (B/L/D): 4★ Holiday Inn Express Urumqi / Weston Hotel or similar                                                                                                                                                                              Tianshan Snow Lotus Pavilion; Flaming Mountains; Karez Well; Turpan Uyghur Family Visit; Urumqi International Grand Bazaar with costume photography.

Day 8 Urumqi (B/L/D): 4★ Holiday Inn Express Urumqi / Weston Hotel or similar       Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps Cultural Exhibition Hall; Tianchi Scenic Area; Hongguang Mountain + Central Asia Regis Square Window; Golden Buddha; Hotan Second Street.

Day 9 Urumqi → Hong Kong → Kuala Lumpur (B/MOB): Tour Ends                                                   Transfer to Urumqi Airport according to flight schedule and fly back to Kuala   Lumpur via Hong Kong.

trips.name: CLASSIC HATYAI-4D2N
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Hatyai: Overnight Journey By Bus                                                                   Gather at KL sentral. Overnight in Bus journey to Hatyai by Bukit Kayu Hitam

Day 2 Wang Kelian Border → Hatyai: 3★ Hatyai – Hotel Accommodation (Arrival & Sightseeing Day)                                                                                                                                 Proceed through Malaysia and Thailand immigration at Wang Kelian Border; continue to Hatyai for Bee Farm, local nuts/snacks shop and Nora Plaza. Check in at the hotel and enjoy free time. In the evening, explore Lee Garden area for shopping and dinner at own expense.

Day 3 Hatyai → Songkhla: 3★ Hatyai – Hotel Accommodation (Sightseeing & Leisure Day) - Visit an elephant attraction; continue to Samila Beach, Songkhla Mosque and Floating Market. Enjoy free time in the evening, with an optional visit to ASEAN Night Market by tuk-tuk at own expense.

Day 4 Hatyai → Danok → Kuala Lumpur: Tour Ends                                                                       Check out from the hotel and depart Hatyai for the border. Stop for shopping in Danok before completing immigration procedures and continuing the journey back to Malaysia. Tour ends with wonderful memories of Hatyai & Songkhla.

trips.name: SHANGHAI-5D4N (MUSLIM FRIENDLY)
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Shanghai → Suzhou (MOB/_/D): Suzhou – Hotel Accommodation (Arrival Day)                                                                                                                                             Gather at KLIA for check-in and flight to Shanghai, then transfer to Suzhou. Visit Jinji Lake, an open park in Suzhou with attractions such as Li's Causeway; take photos at the Oriental Gateway and Bird's Nest; and stroll and shop along Qili Shantang Street. Dinner and overnight in Suzhou. (Meals: Inflight Meal, Dinner)

Day 2 Suzhou → Hangzhou(B/L/D): Hangzhou – Hotel Accommodation (Heritage & Shopping Day)                                                                                                                                      Breakfast and check out from the hotel. Visit the World Cultural Heritage site and Couple's Retreat Garden, then shop at the Silk Factory, known for pillowcases, bedding, clothing and more. Continue to Hangzhou to visit the G20 City Balcony and shop at Sasseur Outlets for the latest clothing and handbag fashions. Overnight in Hangzhou.

Day 3 Hangzhou → Shanghai(B/L/D): Shanghai – Hotel Accommodation (City Sightseeing Day)                                                                                                                                  Breakfast and check out from the hotel. Take a boat ride on West Lake and visit the Longjing Green Tea plantation, then depart for Shanghai with a prayer stop at Pudong Mosque. Take photos at Tian An 1000 Trees, then visit The Bund for photos against the Oriental Pearl Tower and Shanghai Tower. Stroll and shop along Nanjing Pedestrian Street.

Day 4 Shanghai City Tour(B/L/D): Shanghai – Hotel Accommodation (Leisure & Culture Day)                                                                                                                                                      Breakfast at the hotel. Visit the City God Temple Business Circle and Mid Lake Pavilion, then Tongrentang and the Luckin Coffee Garden Villa theme site. Continue to the mosque for prayers, then shop at AP Plaza before returning to the hotel. Overnight in Shanghai.

Day 5 Shanghai → Kuala Lumpur(B/L/MOB): Tour Ends                                                                               Breakfast and check out from the hotel. Shopping at the Florence Town Village outlet, then transfer to Shanghai Airport for the flight back to Kuala Lumpur. Tour ends with wonderful memories of Suzhou, Hangzhou and Shanghai.

trips.name: SHANGHAI DISNEYLAND-5D4N
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Shanghai (MOB/D): 3★ Shanghai – Hotel to be confirmed (Arrival day)                                                                                                                                           Gather at KLIA for flight check-in. Fly from Kuala Lumpur to Shanghai. Upon arrival at Shanghai International Airport, enjoy shopping at Nanjing Pedestrian Street; visit The Bund for photo opportunities with the Oriental Pearl Tower and Shanghai Tower in the background. Transfer to the hotel for check-in. Overnight in Shanghai.

Day 2 Shanghai Disneyland (B): 3★ Shanghai – Hotel to be confirmed (Full-day Disneyland experience)                                                                                                                   Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a full day at Shanghai Disneyland with exciting attractions, parades, shows and magical experiences featuring your favourite Disney characters. Regular admission ticket included. Return to the hotel. Overnight in Shanghai.

Day 3 Shanghai City Tour (B/L/D): 3★ Shanghai – Hotel to be confirmed (City sightseeing and shopping stops)                                                                                                                           Breakfast at the hotel. Explore City God Temple Business District; walk across the historic Nine-Bend Bridge; visit Xiaotaoyuan Mosque. Visit Tong Ren Tang Health Center and Jade Treasure Store. Photo stops at Starbucks Bakery Workshop and the LV Giant Ship Flagship Store. Return to the hotel. Overnight in Shanghai.

Day 4 Shanghai Free & Easy (B): 3★ Shanghai – Hotel to be confirmed (Lunch and dinner on own)                                                                                                                        Breakfast at the hotel. Free day to explore Shanghai at your own pace, enjoy shopping, try local food or relax. Overnight in Shanghai.

Day 5 Shanghai → Kuala Lumpur (B/L/MOB): (Departure day; tour ends)                                                 Breakfast at the hotel and check out. Enjoy outlet shopping at Florentia Village. Transfer to Shanghai International Airport for your return flight to Kuala Lumpur. Arrive in Kuala Lumpur.

trips.name: TAIWAN & ALISHAN: JELAJAH ALAM DAN BUDAYA TAIWAN-5H4M
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Taoyuan → Chiayi (MOB/D): Chiayi Hotel (Arrival Day) Gather at KLIA for check-in and board the flight from Kuala Lumpur to Taipei. Upon arrival, dinner at a Halal restaurant; transfer to Chiayi and check in at the hotel.

Day 2 Chiayi → Alishan National Scenic Area (B/L/D): Chiayi Hotel (Alishan Nature & Cultural Experience) Breakfast at hotel. Alishan National Scenic Area; explore Alishan Forest; experience the Alishan Train; Tea Farm; Hinoki Village; Wenhua Night Market. Return to hotel and overnight in Chiayi.

Day 3 Chiayi → Taichung → Taoyuan (B/L/D): Taoyuan Hotel (Sightseeing & Cultural Experience) Breakfast and check out from hotel. Travel from Chiayi towards Taoyuan; Taichung Opera House; Chung She Flower Garden (February–April only); traditional Pineapple Cake making experience; CKS Memorial Hall; pass by the Presidential Palace. Check in and overnight in Taoyuan.

Day 4 Taoyuan → Taipei → Taoyuan (B/L/D): Taoyuan Hotel (Yehliu, Shifen & Taipei City Tour) Breakfast at hotel. Yehliu Geopark; Shifen Old Street; Sky Lantern experience; photo stop at Taipei 101; sightseeing and shopping at Ximending. Return to hotel and overnight in Taoyuan.

Day 5 Taipei → Kuala Lumpur (B/MOB): (Departure transfer according to flight schedule) Breakfast and check out from hotel. Free time until transfer to the airport; board the flight from Taipei to Kuala Lumpur. Tour ends.

trips.name: TAIWAN + TAIPEI 101-5D4N
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Taipei (MOB/D): Taipei Hotel (Arrival & Ximending) Gather at KLIA and board the flight from Kuala Lumpur to Taipei. Upon arrival, visit Taipei Grand Mosque for prayer; shopping and free time at Ximending Street. Check in and overnight in Taipei.

Day 2 Taipei City Tour (B/L/D): Taipei Hotel (Nature & City Sightseeing) Breakfast at hotel. Yangmingshan; Beitou Hot Spring Park; Shilin Official Residence; Dadaocheng Old Street (May–January only). Visit Tamsui Tian Yuan Gong to enjoy the cherry blossoms (February–April only). Return to hotel and overnight in Taipei.

Day 3 Taipei City Tour (B/L/D): Taipei Hotel (Yehliu, Shifen & Taipei Highlights) Breakfast at hotel. Yehliu Geopark; Shifen and Sky Lantern experience; lunch at a local restaurant; Chiang Kai-Shek Memorial Hall (CKS Memorial); photo stop at Taipei 101 (Observatory entrance not included). Return to hotel and overnight in Taipei.

Day 4 Taipei → Yilan → Taipei (B/L/D): Taipei Hotel (Yilan Nature & Hot Spring Experience) Breakfast at hotel. Plum Lake; Luodong Forestry Park; lunch and taste Yilan’s famous Green Onion Cake; enjoy the IY Hot Spring Foot Spa experience. Return to hotel and overnight in Taipei.

Day 5 Taipei → Kuala Lumpur (B/MOB): (Departure transfer according to flight schedule) Breakfast and check out from hotel. Transfer to Taipei Airport and board the flight from Taipei to Kuala Lumpur. Tour ends.

trips.name: JELAJAH SEOUL KOREA MH38/MH39-6D4N
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Incheon (MOB): Incheon Hotel (Arrival Day) Gather at KLIA for check-in and board the flight from Kuala Lumpur to Seoul (Incheon). Upon arrival at Incheon International Airport, transfer to the hotel and overnight in Incheon.

Day 2 Incheon → Nami Island → Garden of Morning Calm → Seoul (B/L/D): Seoul Hotel (Nami Island & Seasonal Experience) Breakfast at hotel. Travel to Chuncheon; take a ferry to Nami Island, famous as a filming location for Winter Sonata; visit Garden of Morning Calm (March–November). During winter (December–February), enjoy a snow experience at the Ski Resort. Dinner and overnight in Seoul. Winter Ski Activity: Ski equipment and ski wear are not included (USD 50 per person).

Day 3 Seoul City Tour (B/L/D): Seoul Hotel (Palace, Shopping & Seoul Highlights) Breakfast at hotel. Cosmetic Outlet; Gyeongbokgung Palace, a historic royal palace from the Joseon Dynasty; free time for shopping at Myeongdong Shopping Street and Namdaemun Shopping Street; visit N Seoul Tower by EV bus (Observatory entrance not included). Dinner, check in and overnight in Seoul. Optional: Hanbok rental at Gyeongbokgung Palace (approximately KRW 20,000 per person).

Day 4 Seoul Free & Easy (B): Seoul Hotel (Free & Easy Day) Breakfast at hotel. Free time to explore Seoul at your own leisure and overnight in Seoul. Optional Tour: From USD 130 per person (minimum 15 persons), including lunch, dinner, tour guide, tipping and Everland Theme Park entrance ticket. Hongdae Shopping Street.

Day 5 Seoul City Tour → Shopping → Incheon Airport (B/L/D): (Seoul City & Shopping Tour) Breakfast at hotel. Red Pine Gallery; visit Itaewon Mosque for prayer and explore Itaewon Shopping Street; Starfield Library at COEX Mall, featuring impressive 13-metre-high bookshelves. Dinner and transfer to Incheon International Airport.
Day 6 Incheon → Kuala Lumpur (MOB): (Departure Day) Board the flight from Incheon to Kuala Lumpur. Arrive in Kuala Lumpur. Tour ends.

trips.name: DANANG, BANA HILLS & HOI AN-4D3N
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Da Nang (MOB/L/D): Da Nang Hotel (Arrival & Da Nang City Tour) Gather at KLIA for check-in and board the flight from Kuala Lumpur to Da Nang. Upon arrival, lunch and prayer; check in at the hotel; Bien Dong Park; My Khe Beach; Love Lock Bridge; Dragon Bridge; shopping at Night Market. Dinner and return to hotel.

Day 2 Son Tra Mountain → Coconut Forest → Hoi An Ancient Town (B/L/D): Da Nang Hotel (Culture & Heritage Tour) Breakfast at hotel. Fishing Village; Son Tra Mountain (Monkey Mountain); Bamboo Charcoal shopping; Han Market; Coconut Forest; Hoi An Ancient Town; Japanese Covered Bridge; Ancient Embassy Hall; Phuc Kien Pagoda. Dinner at local restaurant; return to hotel and overnight in Da Nang.

Day 3 Da Nang → Ba Na Hills → Shopping (B/L/D): Da Nang Hotel (Full-Day Ba Na Hills Experience) Breakfast at hotel. Visit Ba Na Hills; Le Jardin D’Amour (Paradise Garden); Da Nang French Village; halal buffet lunch at Ba Na Hills; Fantasy Park featuring Thrill Zone, Spirit of Adventure and Mystery World. Dinner at a halal restaurant; shopping at Night Market; return to hotel and overnight in Da Nang.

Day 4 Da Nang → Kuala Lumpur (MOB): (Departure Transfer According to Flight Schedule) Check out from hotel and transfer to Da Nang International Airport. Board the flight from Da Nang to Kuala Lumpur. Tour ends.
